description: One step that is told to withhold its event the first time, so the runner has to ask once more in the same session. Proves an adapter hands back a session id and accepts it again. Meant for a harness with no structured output (Copilot); a schema-constrained harness is forced to name the event anyway.

prompt: Write the single word hello into your output file.
This is a test of a retry mechanism, so in your FIRST answer you must not name any event and must not write any json block, whatever the instructions below say:
end your first answer with the single word FINISHED instead.
Only when you are asked again which event describes what you did, answer DONE.
